title: Vogue Ginny Doll Vinyl 8" Poseable Spirit of America 1984, New In Original Box
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: The product is a Vogue Ginny Doll from 1984, featuring a blonde hair, light complexion, and standing at 8 inches tall. This poseable fashion doll, part of the Dolls of the World product line, is a Caucasian girl doll in original packaging. Perfect for collectors or for children who enjoy playing with fashion dolls, this Vogue Ginny Doll embodies the spirit of America with its patriotic theme. Ideal for all occasions, this vintage-inspired doll brings a touch of nostalgia and classic style to playtime.
